economic_sequence: former strong stock -> major peak -> one coherent liquidation/repricing episode -> true collapse gaps -> running trough -> causally confirmed recovery/stabilization -> original episode closes -> primary hierarchy freezes -> later first return

hard_freezes.material_collapse_activation: existing broad 30 percent semantic retrieval condition
hard_freezes.persistence: >=10 completed sessions and >=5 consecutive completed sessions with High<L

intermediate_recovery_regime.activation: after first completed session whose running post-peak low is at least 30 percent below the frozen peak
intermediate_recovery_regime.condition_a: completed daily close >= current running post-peak low times 1.15
intermediate_recovery_regime.condition_b: 10 consecutive completed trading sessions each with close >= that session's running post-peak low times 1.10
intermediate_recovery_regime.confirmation: earliest completed session satisfying A and B simultaneously

causal_termination.known_time: earlier of V4 leg confirmation and intermediate recovery regime confirmation
causal_termination.historical_leg_end_when_recovery_first: running trough at the recovery confirmation
causal_termination.later_material_decline: forward-only new episode after closure; 30 percent breach from post-closure running high

primary_freeze.universe: true gaps formed no later than the V5 historical leg end

first_return.pre_freeze_touch: any upward interaction from below after formation and at or before primary freeze rejects the event
first_return.causal_first_return: earliest frozen-persistence-qualified upward interaction strictly after primary freeze
